atoms.exact_source_text: The following are deliberate absences, not incomplete subsystems:
atoms.normalized_claim: The items listed following this statement are deliberate design absences, not incomplete subsystems.

atoms.exact_source_text: No inventory grid, encumbrance puzzle, item passing action, Field inventory, or between-Encounter loadout management.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is deliberately no inventory grid, encumbrance puzzle, item passing action, Field inventory, or between-Encounter loadout management.

atoms.exact_source_text: No direct Focus selector, Focus meter, Focus progression, or individual skill-check layer.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is deliberately no direct Focus selector, Focus meter, Focus progression, or individual skill-check layer.

atoms.exact_source_text: No equipment proficiencies, Role-gated Tool classes, species aptitude bonuses, Tool levels, or unique ordinary Tool riders.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is deliberately no equipment proficiencies, Role-gated Tool classes, species aptitude bonuses, Tool levels, or unique ordinary Tool riders.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Weapon class or separate combat economy.
